explanation: Use the first k steps of Fisher–Yates: at step i swap a uniformly chosen remaining position into slot i. Every k-element subset is equally likely in the resulting prefix.
timeComplexity: O(k) sampling time; the supplied wrapper performs repeated statistical trials.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary sampling space, excluding the wrapper’s copied inputs and samples.
